rows.text: THE RICHAT STRUCTURE IS SITUATED NEAR
WITHIN THE ADRAR REGION OF MAURITANIA
VISIBLE FROM SPACE AS A MASSIVE
FORMATION HAS SERVED AS A VISUAL
REFERENCE POINT FOR SPACE SHUTTLE CREWS
THE SEDIMENTARY ROCK LAYERS THAT FORM
THE OUTER RINGS OF THE STRUCTURE
ABOUT 30 METRES WIDE AND AN OUTER
AT THE CORE, BY ONE ESTIMATE
THE HEART OF THE STRUCTURE FEATURES
A SILICEOUS BRECCIA COVERING AN AREA
REACHING A THICKNESS OF AT LEAST 40 METRES
OF THE RICHAT STRUCTURE WERE ONCE
HOWEVER, THE IMPACT THEORY WAS DISPROVED
TIMELINE: DATING OF THE CARBONATITE ROCKS
EVENT THAT PRODUCED THE CENTRAL BRECCIA
MIDDLE STONE AGE ATERIAN TOOLS DATING
STONE BURIAL MOUNDS BUILT IN VARIOUS
LINE THE PROTRUDING DIKES OF THE FORMATION
WHILE THESE MATERIAL FINDS DOCUMENT HUMAN
THE FORMATION AS PLATO'S LOST CITY
OF ATLANTIS ARE REFUTED BY GEOLOGICAL
REALITY, AS THE FEATURE IS AN ANCIENT
DOME RATHER THAN A SUNKEN ISLAND
THE RICHAT STRUCTURE HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED
AS AN ERODED GEOLOGICAL DOME SHAPED
AS ONE OF THE WORLD'S FIRST
WITH ITS ORIGIN GROUNDED IN VERIFIED
INSIDE THE DARK GRAY BASALT MAUSOLEUM
SOUND WAVES ARE GUIDED CONTINUOUSLY ALONG
BRICKS OF VARYING DIMENSIONS WITH LIME
UPON MOHAMMAD ADIL SHAH'S DEATH, LEAVING
YET THE UNFINISHED MONUMENT STILL PROMPTS
MODERN BUILDERS TO WONDER HOW ANCIENT
A CATACLYSM STRUCK BY ONE ESTIMATE
SQUARE MILES OF TAIGA FOREST, FLATTENING
TREES IN A DISTINCTIVE RADIAL PATTERN
RELEASED BETWEEN 10 AND 15 MEGATONS OF TNT
AND WERE DETECTED BY BAROGRAPHS WORLDWIDE
THE EVENT TO AN ATMOSPHERIC METEOR
AIR BURST, THOUGH NO CELESTIAL FRAGMENT
SOLDIERS OF ARMY GROUP NORTH DISASSEMBLED
AND CONTAINED OVER 13,000 POUNDS OF AMBER
INVESTIGATIONS CONCLUDE THE ROOM WAS MOST
AN ORIGINAL STONE MOSAIC WAS RECOVERED
THE TEXT IS WRITTEN FROM LEFT
TO RIGHT IN AN UNIDENTIFIED SCRIPT
THE TEXT CONFORMS TO ZIPF'S LAW
WHERE THE MOST COMMON WORD APPEARS
THE MANUSCRIPT IS NAMED AFTER POLISH
CRYPTOGRAPHERS FROM BOTH WORLD WAR ONE
TO DECIPHER THE CODEX WITHOUT SUCCESS
